text: 今晚将公布的美国9月CPI报告将决定2027年美国社会保障福利的生活成本调整（COLA）幅度。根据美国社会保障局的计算规则，年度COLA取决于第三季度（7月至9月）城市工薪阶层和文职人员消费者价格指数（CPI-W）平均值相较上年同期的涨幅。劳工统计局数据显示，7月CPI-W指数为327.104，同比上涨3.4%；8月指数升至328.481，同比上涨3.5%。今晚公布的9月CPI-W数据将补齐第三季度最后一个月的数据，并据此确定2027年社保福利的最终上调幅度。最新预测显示，2027年COLA可能达到3.5%，高于2026年的2.8%，有望创三年来最大涨幅
text_en: The US September CPI report to be released tonight will determine the size of the cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) for US Social Security benefits in 2027. According to the calculation rules of the US Social Security Administration, the annual COLA depends on the year-on-year increase in the average Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers (CPI-W) for the third quarter (July to September). Bureau of Labor Statistics data show that the July CPI-W index was 327.104, up 3.4% year-on-year; the August index rose to 328.481, up 3.5% year-on-year. The September CPI-W data released tonight will complete the final month of the third quarter and determine the final increase in Social Security benefits for 2027. The latest forecasts show that the 2027 COLA may reach 3.5%, higher than 2.8% in 2026, and may be the largest increase in three years.
